policies.heading: Package Payment Policy
policies.subheading: All packages require full payment for the entire package before scheduling. You can register, pay and schedule online, or call our office (702) 747-5998 to pay, register and schedule over the phone if you prefer.

policies.heading: Refund Policy
policies.subheading: If a refund is requested after lessons or packages are purchased, there is a $40 administrative fee to process the refund. No refunds are issued after six month from the date of purchase. Refunds take 5-10 business days for processing.

policies.heading: Lessons Cancellation
policies.subheading: 24 hours notice is required to cancel a driving lesson without penalty. If you cancel with less than 24 hours notice but no later than 3 hours before your lesson, there will be a $80 charge for rescheduling.

policies.heading: Lateness Policy
policies.subheading: If you arrive late, up to 15 minutes past the start time, the lesson will still end at the scheduled stop time.

policies.heading: No-Show Policy
policies.subheading: If you are more than 15 minutes late without prior notice, the lesson will be considered a no-show. No rescheduling or refund will be provided, and the lesson is forfeited.

policies.heading: Permit/License Requirements
policies.subheading: If you do not have a valid Nevada Learner's Permit, Driver's License or International License in your possession at the time of the lesson, the lesson cannot be given. There will be a $80 charge for the lesson to be rescheduled.

policies.heading: Please Note
policies.subheading: Late cancellations or lessons cancelled due to no-show or no permit/license result in a loss of income to instructors and our driving school that cannot be recovered otherwise.

policies.heading: Certificate of Completion
policies.subheading: After 3 lessons/6 hours of behind-the-wheel driving lessons are completed, RoadReady Driving School will issue a Certificate of Completion. This may be helpful with car insurance; check with your provider.

policies.heading: Prices
policies.subheading: Prices are effective at the time of purchase. Prices are subject to change without notice.

policies.heading: Expiration
policies.subheading: All packages expire six months from the date of purchase.
